content:
Hi Test Contact, A mutual contact suggested I reach out.

I’ve been speaking with teams at regional bank about how key financial metrics like DSCR and income are verified.

One thing that keeps coming up is that reported numbers often aren’t independently re-checked.

In one case, a DSCR was reported as 1.42 but recalculated closer to 1.18 — something that could have easily passed through.

Given your role as a lending leader, I was curious how your team currently catches issues like that.
